label: Crystal
release_note: First official compiler release 0.1.0 on 18 June 2014, documented by the language team's 19 June announcement; this basis is distinct from development start or 1.0.
language_style: General-purpose object-oriented language with Ruby-inspired syntax, compiled static checking and fibers/channels.

runtime_support_by_benchmark.regexredux: Crystal standard Regex/IO and PCRE2 10.49 nonoverlapping matching/ordered replacement; ordinary Boehm GC and system C/libiconv. Workload orchestration is authored Crystal.
runtime_support_by_benchmark.revcomp: Crystal standard strings/buffers/IO and ordinary Boehm GC; authored complete FASTA/IUPAC reversal loops.
runtime_support_by_benchmark.pidigits: Crystal standard BigInt backed by generic GMP 6.3.0, including both actual extraction divisions; ordinary Boehm GC. Pi recurrence and output are authored Crystal.
runtime_support_by_benchmark.spectralnorm: Crystal arrays, numeric operations, fibers/channels and ordinary Boehm GC; authored matrix-element/product/transpose iteration loops.
runtime_support_by_benchmark.mandelbrot: Crystal numeric operations, row buffers, fibers/channels and ordinary Boehm GC; authored complete complex recurrence and packed output.
runtime_support_by_benchmark.fasta: Crystal buffers/IO and ordinary Boehm GC; authored repeated emission, LCG and probability selection.
runtime_support_by_benchmark.knucleotide: Crystal standard growing Hash maps, buffers/IO, fibers/channels and ordinary Boehm GC; all seven complete maps/windows remain authored Crystal work.
runtime_support_by_benchmark.binarytrees: Crystal reference objects, ordinary Boehm GC, fibers/channels and IO; actual newly allocated leaf/interior nodes, recursive checks and long-lived retained root.
runtime_support_by_benchmark.nbody: Crystal numeric/array operations and ordinary Boehm GC; authored momentum, all pairwise forces/position steps and two energy calculations.
runtime_support_by_benchmark.fannkuchredux: Crystal arrays, numeric operations, fibers/channels and ordinary Boehm GC; authored permutation/rank/flip/checksum loops.

timing_boundary: Three complete sequential fresh native processes per exact source in rotated rounds with a fresh unchanged Mech AOT control for each workload. Includes startup, complete canonical input, workload computation, full stdout and teardown; all outputs validated after timing. No warmed/persistent process filtering. All native/compiler/QA work shares one mutex, AC power and Low Power Mode off, at most 8 compute workers, fixed time/RSS limits.
source_provenance: Twenty locally authored/adapted compact/optimized Crystal applications implementing the prescribed CLBG algorithms. Published algorithm examples and original archive remain immutable; every scored main is separately compiler-bound and counted. No published Crystal performance sample is reused. Generic standard libraries/runtime are separately pinned; no external benchmark executor or domain kernel is introduced.

expected_evidence.gc_selection: Pinned source chooses gc/boehm unless gc_none or wasm32 flag. Every actual original/fresh scored build command must lack either flag; environment must lack compiler/runtime GC-disabling injections. Boehm is statically supplied by unchanged official package, so dynamic-image listing alone cannot prove/exclude its presence.
expected_evidence.input_inventory: The separately qualified LOC overlay supplies all 20 original/fresh actual build receipts and measured-source/binary hashes. Sealer must reconcile every inventory against all 20 independently reconciled measured rows, actual command/build/native-image/runtime pins and full report/manifest/source lineage.

primary_source_review: Read official 2014 announcement, versioned 1.21 runtime library/compiler docs and exact 73ea5c2b GC selection source; read pinned Linguist Crystal color entry. Claims are paraphrased; local actual receipts establish measured compiler/runtime, not website version metadata.
